notes: Experimental low-Mach thermal LBM driving fixed-mesh linear structural dynamics.
Pressure and viscous link loads are interval constant; stresses derive from supported tetrahedral mechanics.
Only fluid topology coordinates vary; mesh, supports, material and interface map stay fixed.
Optional isotropic thermal strain uses fixed-solid temperature interpolation; no damage feedback or moving-wall/two-way mechanics.
Optional calibrated rainflow usage observes solved structural stress with prescribed or explicitly mapped solved-solid temperature admission; no fatigue adjoint or constitutive damage.
Requires temporal, spatial and calibrated-material validation; not qualified by admission checks.

fatigue.title: Optional calibrated rainflow fatigue observer
fatigue.description: Optional S-N surface: provenance, stress_measure, amplitudes_Pa, mean_stresses_Pa, cycles_to_failure, solid_temperature_K, T_min_K, T_max_K, initial_usage. Prescribed solid temperature; no automatic life extrapolation. Evaluation-only observer, not a differentiable objective. Optional temperature_source="solved_solid" uses the thermal_expansion fixed-solid temperature map and checks every endpoint against calibration limits. No temperature-dependent life law is inferred.

structure.title: Solid mesh, supports and wall-link interpolation
structure.description: One-way fixed-wall loading. Explicit link indices and nonnegative weights must reproduce interface positions. Optional thermal_expansion contains per-element coefficient_per_K and stress_free_temperature_K; centroids interpolate only fixed solid-cell temperatures. Zero initial motion and fixed supports. Requires JAX x64.

title: Lattice Boltzmann + heat + wall-loaded structure, experimental
